description: This file provides classes and functions for supporting OpenAI's GPT models within a larger AI/ML framework. It includes configuration management (`OpenAIGPTConfig`), request and response transformation, URL handling, environment validation, and streaming response handling specific to OpenAI's API and models.

classes.name: OpenAIGPTConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for OpenAI GPT models, managing various parameters for API calls, including token limits, temperature, and function call handling.

classes.name: OpenAIChatCompletionStreamingHandler
classes.description: Handles streaming of chat completion responses from OpenAI API, parsing chunks into a standardized format.
